calibration.objective: keep wrong approve drafts out of automatic finalization at recall >= 0.90

demotions: fitted and measured on the same golden set (prior-auth-determinations-v1@1.0.0); no held-out confirmation
thresholds.note: Auto-finalization requires confidence at or above this value. The repository's decision log (D3) says a fixed 0.85 is uncalibrated and plausibly too strict or too lax; nothing derives it. The source pins the default only: it is read from the CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD environment variable, so a deployment that sets it runs a value this evidence does not describe.

No ceiling exists. `coverage_report()` measures the verified/provisional split and publishes it; nothing consumes the number to gate anything. That is a defensible design — reporting without gating is honest — but it means any claim that the concept map is fit for clinical exchange has no decision boundary behind it. Recorded as a threshold with no implementation so the absence is visible rather than inferred.
